import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] field, capsule;
    static int[][] Z, S;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static boolean isDigit(char ch) {
        return ch >= '1' && ch <= '9';
    }

    static boolean in(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    static class Flow {
        int[] head, cur, d;
        Edge[] E;
        int tot, src, sink;
        int N;
        final int MAXE = 200000;

        class Edge {
            int v, nxt, cap;
            Edge(int v, int nxt, int cap) {
                this.v = v;
                this.nxt = nxt;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        Flow(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            head = new int[N];
            cur = new int[N];
            d = new int[N];
            E = new Edge[MAXE];
            init();
        }

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            tot = 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
            E[tot] = new Edge(v, head[u], cap);
            head[u] = tot++;
            E[tot] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0);
            head[v] = tot++;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, cur, 0, N);
            d[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(src);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = E[i].nxt) {
                    int v = E[i].v;
                    if (d[v] == -1 && E[i].cap > 0) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        Q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int in) {
            if (u == sink) return in;
            int flow = 0;
            int i = cur[u];
            while (i != -1) {
                int v = E[i].v;
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && E[i].cap > 0) {
                    int f = dfs(v, Math.min(in - flow, E[i].cap));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        flow += f;
                        E[i].cap -= f;
                        E[i ^ 1].cap += f;
                        if (flow == in) {
                            cur[u] = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                i = E[i].nxt;
                cur[u] = i;
            }
            if (flow < in) d[u] = -1;
            return flow;
        }

        int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
            src = _src;
            sink = _sink;
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                flow += dfs(src, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int x, int y, int[][] d, boolean f, Flow F) {
        int sx = x, sy = y;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        d[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(x);
        Q.add(y);
        if (f && isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            F.add(sx * n + sy, sx * n + sy + n * n, INF);
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            x = Q.poll();
            y = Q.poll();
            if (d[x][y] == t) break;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x + dx[o];
                int yy = y + dy[o];
                if (in(xx, yy) && d[xx][yy] == INF && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == d[x][y] + 1 && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                        if (f && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            F.add(sx * n + sy, xx * n + yy + n * n, INF);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || !f) {
                            Q.add(xx);
                            Q.add(yy);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        field = new char[n][n];
        capsule = new char[n][n];
        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            field[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            capsule[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        int nodeCount = n * n * 2 + 2;
        int src = n * n * 2;
        int sink = src + 1;
        Flow F = new Flow(nodeCount);
        Z = new int[n][n];
        S = new int[n][n];
        // zombie BFS
        bfs(zx, zy, Z, false, F);
        // add edges from capsule cells to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    F.add(i * n + j + n * n, sink, capsule[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        // for each field digit
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(field[i][j])) {
                    F.add(src, i * n + j, field[i][j] - '0');
                    bfs(i, j, S, true, F);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(F.dinic(src, sink));
    }
}
